boundaries: All proposed outlines are our analysis, not the developers original planning documents.
Separate excerpts are not presented as one uninterrupted play session.
Source footage is normal speed. No replay loops, countdown, static discussion or promotional time-lapse filling the body.
Do not infer a completed successful ride, happiness change, queue construction or productivity effect from an unconfirmed preview.
